name: Silent Image
desc: You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon no larger than a 15-foot cube. The image has no sound, smell or other sensory effects, and physical interaction reveals it as an illusion. As a Magic action you can move it within range. A creature that takes a Study action can make an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to discern it. Concentration, up to 10 minutes.
